tools.name: list_pay_transparency_laws
tools.description: Lists pay transparency laws with status (in force, enacted not yet in force, pending, EU transposition overdue), start date, who is covered and what a posting must include. Filter by country ("US", "CA", "EU" or an EU country name) and status. Free.

tools.name: list_upcoming_pay_transparency_changes

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_job_post · Public sink: check_job_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_job_post · Public sink: check_job_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
